limitations: Validation plants historically inspected; not external holdout.
AABB path clearance is conservative engineering screening, not flight certification.
No plants, neighbors, materials, terrain, sky, marker or training changes.
No implicit reidentification or metric localization claim; common marker may be outside near views or invisible on its back.
If preflight fails preserve evidence and do not jump camera, relocate plants or markers.
Private geometry permits camera construction and evaluator checks only; never estimator input.
Projection coverage is geometric frustum coverage, not actual visibility or an occlusion rate.
One unchanged common front ArUco8 only. C07 has no independent marker acquisition and backside marker visibility is not promised.
Orbit blocked sectors remain negative evidence; no full circle claim for partial routes.
Different route durations include declared inspection, acquisition and transit phases.
